transcript.text: Alright everyone, we've got a ten-business-day stability sprint coming up with capacity for one primary technical-debt focus. The three candidates on the table are legacy_csv_exporter, webhook_retry_service, and admin_search_index. Before I lock the plan, I want to do our normal round-robin check-in. Backend engineering, security engineering, and customer support — let's hear your input on which of these three should be the priority. Who wants to go first?

transcript.text: While finishing an unrelated export ticket this afternoon, I confirmed that legacy_csv_exporter already has six of its eight endpoint migrations completed. Exactly two endpoints remain, and the backend team can finish those two within this sprint. I haven't updated the planning board yet, but this means legacy_csv_exporter is much closer to done than the board suggests.
